title: File:Scar, two months after total thyrodectomy.jpg
author: Starvee44 at English Wikipedia
description: A total thyrodectomy was performed on this person, as part of his treatment for Graves' disease. The operation took place on february 2, 2010. The picture was taken ten weeks after that.Starvee44 (talk) 14:10, 24 April 2010 (UTC)
